outcome: Risk of radiation-induced cancer in childhood
cohort: 42 patients with placenta praevia and/or placenta accreta spectrum undergoing prophylactic internal iliac artery occlusion during Caesarean section
finding: Prophylactic occlusion of the internal iliac arteries during Caesarean section in patients with abnormal placentation resulted in a low estimated fetal radiation dose and a very low risk of radiation-induced cancer in childhood.
